name: Environment and reproducibility
notes: Captures Python/OS/package versions, git commit, and seed for every subsequent stage.

name: Dataset acquisition / integrity
notes: Official UCI archive downloaded and SHA-256 verified against the published archive hash.

name: Dataset validation
notes: Verified 13,910 samples, 128 features, 10 batches, 6 classes; 0 missing values.

name: Chronological split definition
notes: FIXED_ORIGIN (train batch 1, test 2-10), EXPANDING_WINDOW, and IID_DIAGNOSTIC protocols frozen in config.

name: Preprocessing
notes: Standardization fitted on training data only per protocol; no leakage across chronological boundary.

name: Baseline model training
notes: Logistic Regression, Random Forest, RBF-SVM, MLP trained on Batch 1 (seed 42).

name: Chronological evaluation
notes: All 4 models evaluated on batches 2-10 under FIXED_ORIGIN, EXPANDING_WINDOW, and IID_DIAGNOSTIC.

name: Drift analysis
notes: Per-feature and global drift (normalized Wasserstein, standardized mean shift) vs. Batch 1.

name: Evidence-based model selection
notes: Claim-evidence matrix (paper/claim_evidence_matrix.csv) links each candidate claim to its artifact; C006 explicitly UNSUPPORTED.

name: Resource-aware XAI
notes: EXP-XAI-0001 (registry rows EXP-XAI-0001-C1..C4). Intrinsic coefficient explanations for MODEL-C1, intrinsic impurity for MODEL-C2, model-agnostic permutation importance (macro-F1) and single-feature-ablation local explanations for all 4 frozen FIXED_ORIGIN models. No retraining; chronological split unchanged. Full applicability matrix in results/xai/stage09_manifest.csv. See docs/experiments/STAGE09_RESOURCE_AWARE_XAI.md. This stage prepares evidence for Stages 10-12 — it does not itself report fidelity, stability, or latency conclusions.
